title: pipelines → studio's projector: steers the running turn read
description: From API 1.59 (contracts/README.md, Assistant: steer). Subject `evt.assistant.<thread_id>.steered` (stream EVT, durable `studio-assistant`, in order with the chat's steps), Nats-Msg-Id `<thread_id>:steered:<first steer id>`. Published at a step boundary when the turn took steers into its transcript, before its next model call. Studio sets each one's entry `steer` read (its `at` now, so it shows where it was read) and sends it; an id not waiting is skipped.

turn.description: the message turn that read them

steer_ids.description: in the order they were sent
